Run this document from top to bottom once. It saves `results/analysis_results.rds`.
Then open `02_figures.Rmd` to edit figures without rerunning these analyses.

## 1. Packages and directories

Open `Mammals_analysis.Rproj` first, then run this document in a fresh R
session. Paths are relative to the extracted archive folder; no personal
computer path is required. When knitting, R Markdown uses this Rmd's folder.
If working without an RStudio project, set your working directory to the
folder containing this document before running chunks.

Input tables are in `to rerun the archived code/`. Daily detections, survey
dates, and the site-ordering table are in its `detection data/` subfolder.
The setup checks that all required input files are present.

CSV tables are written to `results/tables/`. Rerunning the analysis replaces
these outputs and, after successful completion, the saved RDS file.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, error = FALSE, cache = FALSE)
library(unmarked)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
library(e1071)
library(pairwiseAdonis)

# Only the four directories used by this analysis; all paths are relative.
data_dir <- "to rerun the archived code"
detection_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "detection data")
results_dir <- "results"
tables_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "tables")

required_inputs <- c(
  "Corrected_Fire_Metrics_6-11-26.csv",
  "detection data/det_his_forordering.csv",
  "detection data/survey_visit_dates_julian_day_level_correct.csv",
  "detection data/y_American_Black_Bear.csv",
  "detection data/y_California_Ground_Squirrel.csv",
  "detection data/y_Coyote.csv",
  "detection data/y_Douglas's_Squirrel.csv",
  "detection data/y_Golden_Mantled_Ground_Squirrel.csv",
  "detection data/y_Grey_Fox.csv",
  "detection data/y_Mule_Deer.csv",
  "detection data/y_Striped_Skunk.csv",
  "detection data/y_Western_Gray_Squirrel.csv",
  "filtered_deployments_detailed_func_dates3.csv",
  "Full_EnvCovariates_ForWildlife_Dec17-25.csv",
  "images_2007979.csv",
  "Mammals_groups.csv",
  "plot_fire_metrics_1_rev_05082026.csv",
  "plot_fire_metrics_suppl_4_061126.csv",
  "plot_info_2025.csv",
  "plot_info_with_topographic_data.csv",
  "plot_level_means_fuentes_inputs.csv",
  "struc_from_veg_analysis.csv"
)
missing_inputs <- required_inputs[!file.exists(file.path(data_dir, required_inputs))]
if (length(missing_inputs)) {
  stop("Missing archive inputs. Open Mammals_analysis.Rproj (or set the working directory to this archive). Missing files: ",
       paste(missing_inputs, collapse = ", "))
}

dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(tables_dir, "model predictions"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(tables_dir, "simulations"), showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(123)
```

## 2. Prepare the model inputs

The ordering table defines the included deployments and the row order used throughout the analysis.

```{r site-order}
det_his_forordering <- read.csv(file.path(detection_dir, "det_his_forordering.csv"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(det_his_forordering$deployment_id),
          !anyDuplicated(det_his_forordering$deployment_id))
```

Use the same vegetation variables and transformations as in the original document.

```{r vegetation-transformations}
struc <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "struc_from_veg_analysis.csv")) %>% dplyr::select("X.1", "lg_snag_ha", "dens_lg", "dens_md", "cwd_m3_", "fuel_kgha",
  "gr.mean.percent.shrub", "gr.mean.percent.herbGrass", "mean_cc_90", "vert_div",
  "tree_rich", "herb_rich", "shrub_rich",
  "Snag_Density_Diameter_Med_per_Hectare",
  "Densiometer_CV",
  "Tree.Density.Diameter.Class.Saplings.Hectare",
  "Tree.Density.Diameter.Class.Small.Hectare")
nrow(struc)
site_cov  <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "Full_EnvCovariates_ForWildlife_Dec17-25.csv")) %>% dplyr::select(Plot, y_ca_alb)

nrow(site_cov)
struc <- merge(struc, site_cov, by.x = "X.1", by.y="Plot", all.x=T)
nrow(struc)

struc <- struc[match(det_his_forordering$plot_id, struc$X.1), ]
struc$herb_rich <- log1p(struc$herb_rich)
struc$cwd_m3_ <- log1p(struc$cwd_m3_)
struc$lg_snag_ha <- log1p(struc$lg_snag_ha)
struc$Tree.Density.Diameter.Class.Saplings.Hectare <- log1p(struc$Tree.Density.Diameter.Class.Saplings.Hectare)
struc$Tree.Density.Diameter.Class.Small.Hectare <- log1p(struc$Tree.Density.Diameter.Class.Small.Hectare)

struc$gr.mean.percent.shrub <- sqrt(struc$gr.mean.percent.shrub)
struc$gr.mean.percent.herbGrass <- sqrt(struc$gr.mean.percent.herbGrass)

struc$vert_div <- bestNormalize::bestNormalize(struc$vert_div)$x.t
struc$Snag_Density_Diameter_Med_per_Hectare <- bestNormalize::bestNormalize(struc$Snag_Density_Diameter_Med_per_Hectare)$x.t
setdiff(det_his_forordering$plot_id, struc$X.1)

struc <- struc[match(det_his_forordering$plot_id, struc$X.1), ]
```

```{r survey-dates}

dates_s <- as.data.frame(dates_s)
```

The model uses daily detections. All detection tables and the site-ordering table are in `detection data/`. The original excluded deployment is retained.

```{r detection-array}
det_matrices <- list()

for (sp in names(species_info)) {

  species <- sp
  sp_columns <- species_info[[sp]]$cols
  species_clean <- species_info[[sp]]$clean

  det_his <- read.csv(file.path(detection_dir, paste0("y_", species, ".csv"))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(deployment_id != "P428_FISHER12_35_2024_TRY2")

  det_his <- det_his[match(det_his_forordering$deployment_id, det_his$deployment_id), ]

  det_his_nodep <- det_his %>%
    dplyr::select(-deployment_id, -X)

  det_matrices[[sp]] <- as.matrix(det_his_nodep)
}

n_species <- length(det_matrices)
n_sites   <- nrow(det_matrices[[1]])
n_visits  <- ncol(det_matrices[[1]])

y_array <- array(
  data     = unlist(det_matrices),
  dim      = c(n_sites, n_visits, n_species),
  dimnames = list(
    site    = det_his_forordering$deployment_id,
    visit   = colnames(det_matrices[[1]]),
    species = names(det_matrices)
  )
)

y_array <- aperm(y_array, perm = c(3, 1, 2))

dim(y_array)

y_comm <- aperm(y_array, c(2, 3, 1))
dim(y_comm)

umf_comm <- unmarkedFrameOccuComm(
  y        = y_comm,
  siteCovs = site_cov_s,
  obsCovs  = list(dates = dates_s)
)
```

These checks stop obvious row/column mismatches. The missing-date audit documents the existing discrepancy without filling dates or changing detections.

```{r input-checks}
stopifnot(nrow(site_cov_s) == nrow(det_his_forordering),
          !anyNA(site_cov_s),
          nrow(dates_s) == nrow(det_his_forordering))
for (sp in names(det_matrices)) {
  stopifnot(identical(dim(det_matrices[[sp]]), dim(as.matrix(dates))),
            identical(colnames(det_matrices[[sp]]), colnames(dates)))
}

missing_dates <- data.frame()
for (sp in names(det_matrices)) {
  missing <- which(!is.na(det_matrices[[sp]]) & is.na(as.matrix(dates)), arr.ind = TRUE)
  missing_dates <- rbind(missing_dates, data.frame(
    species = rep(sp, nrow(missing)),
    deployment_id = det_his_forordering$deployment_id[missing[, 1]],
    visit = colnames(dates)[missing[, 2]],
    detection = det_matrices[[sp]][missing]))
}
write.csv(missing_dates, file.path(tables_dir, "observations_missing_dates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if (nrow(missing_dates) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(missing_dates), " species/visit observations lack survey dates; see observations_missing_dates.csv. The original inputs and model handling are retained.")
}
```

## 3. Compare the eight candidate community occupancy models

These formulas follow the predictor memberships in manuscript Table S1. Model 6
is the existing selected model (`m6`); it remains the source of occupancy
predictions. The comparison reports both AIC and AICc, parameter counts,
delta values, AICc weights, and fitting diagnostics. Failed fits are retained
in the table and excluded from ranking.

AICc uses 97 sampling sites as `nobs`, explicitly, and counts both fixed-effect
and random-effect variance parameters. The correction is
`AICc = AIC + 2*K*(K+1)/(n_sites-K-1)`. Existing scores near 9287 in the
manuscript are AIC values; the regenerated AICc column should be used when
reporting AICc. See the [AICcmodavg documentation](https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/AICcmodavg/html/AICc.html).
Review optimizer warnings and the regenerated comparison before updating Table S1.
The code does not silently select a different model for subsequent analyses.

```{r occupancy-model}
if (!requireNamespace("AICcmodavg", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install AICcmodavg before running the candidate-model comparison.")
}
# Eight hypotheses in Table S1, in the manuscript's model-number order.
# Keep daily Julian date (dates) in detection for every occupancy candidate.
candidate_formulas <- list(
  model1 = ~ dates ~ dens_lg + Tree.Density.Diameter.Class.Small.Hectare + mean_cc_90 + gr.mean.percent.shrub + gr.mean.percent.herbGrass + vert_div + aet_mean_1ha,
  model2 = ~ dates ~ dens_lg + lg_snag_ha + Densiometer_CV + cwd_m3_ + gr.mean.percent.shrub + vert_div + topo_prod_mean_1ha,
  model3 = ~ dates ~ lg_snag_ha + mean_cc_90 + Densiometer_CV + shrub_rich + herb_rich + vert_div + topo_prod_mean_1ha,
  model4 = ~ dates ~ dens_lg + lg_snag_ha + mean_cc_90 + tree_rich + cwd_m3_ + vert_div + aet_mean_1ha,
  model5 = ~ dates ~ dens_md + mean_cc_90 + Densiometer_CV + gr.mean.percent.shrub + gr.mean.percent.herbGrass + vert_div + aet_mean_1ha,
  model6 = ~ dates ~ dens_lg + lg_snag_ha + mean_cc_90 + gr.mean.percent.shrub + gr.mean.percent.herbGrass + vert_div + aet_mean_1ha,
  model7 = ~ dates ~ dens_lg + lg_snag_ha + Densiometer_CV + gr.mean.percent.shrub + vert_div + aet_mean_1ha,
  model8 = ~ dates ~ Tree.Density.Diameter.Class.Small.Hectare + lg_snag_ha + mean_cc_90 + cwd_m3_ + gr.mean.percent.shrub + aet_mean_1ha
)
selected_model_id <- "model6"  # Manuscript model 6 in Table S1.
aicc_n_sites <- unmarked::numSites(umf_comm)
stopifnot(aicc_n_sites == 97L)
candidate_model_specs <- data.frame(
  model = names(candidate_formulas),
  formula = vapply(candidate_formulas, function(x) paste(deparse(x), collapse = " "), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.csv(candidate_model_specs, file.path(tables_dir, "occupancy_candidate_formulas.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

fit_occupancy_candidate <- function(formula, model_id, data, n_sites) {
  fit_warnings <- character()
  error_text <- ""
  fit <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(
    unmarked::occuComm(formula, data = data),
    warning = function(w) {
      fit_warnings <<- c(fit_warnings, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }), error = function(e) { error_text <<- conditionMessage(e); NULL })
  row <- data.frame(model = model_id, n_sites = n_sites, K = NA_real_,
                    logLik = NA_real_, AIC = NA_real_, AICc = NA_real_,
                    optimizer_code = NA_integer_, finite_fixed_effect_SE = FALSE,
                    eligible = FALSE, status = "fit_failed", warnings = "", error = error_text)
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    row$optimizer_code <- fit@opt$convergence
    # Do not silently compare fits that used different sampling sites.
    same_sites <- length(fit@sitesRemoved) == 0L && unmarked::numSites(fit@data) == n_sites
    row$logLik <- -fit@negLogLike
    row$AIC <- fit@AIC
    # AICcmodavg includes the estimated random-effect variance parameters in K.
    # length(coef(fit)) alone would undercount parameters for occuComm.
    ic <- tryCatch(list(K = AICcmodavg::AICc(fit, return.K = TRUE),
                        AICc = AICcmodavg::AICc(fit, nobs = n_sites)),
                   error = function(e) { row$error <<- conditionMessage(e); NULL })
    if (!is.null(ic)) {
      row$K <- ic$K
      if (n_sites > row$K + 1) row$AICc <- ic$AICc
      stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(row$AIC, -2 * row$logLik + 2 * row$K, tolerance = 1e-7)))
    }
    fixed_var <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(diag(vcov(fit))), error = function(e) NA_real_)
    row$finite_fixed_effect_SE <- length(fixed_var) > 0L && all(is.finite(fixed_var) & fixed_var >= 0)
    row$eligible <- same_sites && identical(as.integer(row$optimizer_code), 0L) &&
      is.finite(row$AICc) && row$finite_fixed_effect_SE
    row$status <- if (!same_sites) "different_sites" else if (row$optimizer_code != 0L) {
      "optimizer_failed"
    } else if (!row$finite_fixed_effect_SE) "nonfinite_standard_errors" else if (!is.finite(row$AICc)) {
      "AICc_unavailable"
    } else "converged"
  }
  row$warnings <- paste(unique(fit_warnings), collapse = " | ")
  list(fit = fit, statistics = row)
}

# All candidates are refitted from the same input frame; failed fits remain in
# the exported table, but receive no delta, weight, or rank.
candidate_fits <- vector("list", length(candidate_formulas))
names(candidate_fits) <- names(candidate_formulas)
for (id in names(candidate_formulas)) {
  message("Fitting Table S1 ", id)
  candidate_fits[[id]] <- fit_occupancy_candidate(candidate_formulas[[id]], id, umf_comm, aicc_n_sites)
  # Save progress after each model in case a later fit is interrupted.
  saveRDS(candidate_fits, file.path(results_dir, "occupancy_candidate_fits.rds"))
}
model_comparison <- do.call(rbind, lapply(candidate_fits, `[[`, "statistics"))
rownames(model_comparison) <- NULL
model_comparison$formula <- candidate_model_specs$formula[match(model_comparison$model, candidate_model_specs$model)]
model_comparison$delta_AIC <- model_comparison$delta_AICc <- NA_real_
model_comparison$AICc_weight <- NA_real_
model_comparison$AICc_rank <- NA_integer_
ok <- model_comparison$eligible
if (any(ok)) {
  model_comparison$delta_AIC[ok] <- model_comparison$AIC[ok] - min(model_comparison$AIC[ok])
  model_comparison$delta_AICc[ok] <- model_comparison$AICc[ok] - min(model_comparison$AICc[ok])
  weights <- exp(-0.5 * model_comparison$delta_AICc[ok])
  model_comparison$AICc_weight[ok] <- weights / sum(weights)
  model_comparison$AICc_rank[ok] <- rank(model_comparison$AICc[ok], ties.method = "min")
}
model_comparison$selected_for_manuscript <- model_comparison$model == selected_model_id
write.csv(model_comparison, file.path(tables_dir, "occupancy_model_comparison_AICc.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(model_comparison[, c("model", "K", "AIC", "AICc", "delta_AICc", "AICc_weight", "status")], row.names = FALSE)
selected_row <- match(selected_model_id, model_comparison$model)
if (!model_comparison$eligible[selected_row]) {
  stop("The manuscript model did not pass fitting checks. Inspect occupancy_model_comparison_AICc.csv before continuing.")
}
if (model_comparison$AICc_rank[selected_row] != 1L) {
  warning("The manuscript model is not the lowest-AICc candidate in this run. Review the comparison; m6 is not switched automatically.")
}
m6 <- candidate_fits[[selected_model_id]]$fit
summary(m6)
rand_est <- randomTerms(m6)
rand_est$Estimate <- round(rand_est$Estimate, 4)
rand_est2 <- randomTerms(m6, addMean = TRUE)
write.csv(rand_est, file.path(tables_dir, "random_effect_deviations.csv"))
write.csv(rand_est2, file.path(tables_dir, "species_coefficients.csv"))
write.csv(model_comparison[selected_row, c("model", "K", "n_sites", "AIC", "AICc")],
          file.path(tables_dir, "occupancy_AIC.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r occupancy-predictions}
pred_comm <- unmarked::predict(m6, type = "state", re.form = NULL)

for (sp in names(pred_comm)) {
  df_out <- data.frame(
    deployment_id = det_his_forordering$deployment_id,
    pred_comm[[sp]]
  )
  write.csv(df_out,
            file = file.path(tables_dir, paste0("model predictions/pred_", sp, ".csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

This is your all-predictor starting set, followed by the existing automated
VIF procedure and forward selection. As in the original `metrics` vector,
elevation is not a candidate and `y_ca_alb` is removed. The alternative manual
VIF branch intended to retain TSLF is not run.

```{r rda-candidate-set}

fire_sc2 <- fire_sc
df_all2 <- cbind(df_all2, fire_sc2)

Y_hell <- decostand(df[, 2:10], "hellinger")

preds_iter <- df_all2
colnames(preds_iter)
colnames(df_all2)
```

The `.drop_aliased()` helper below was already present in your original R Markdown.

```{r rda-vif-filtering}
set.seed(123)
.drop_aliased <- function(preds_df) {
  dummy_y <- rnorm(nrow(preds_df))
  na_coefs <- names(which(is.na(coef(suppressWarnings(lm(dummy_y ~ ., data = preds_df))))))
  if (length(na_coefs) == 0) return(list(data = preds_df, removed = character(0)))
  col_names <- names(preds_df)
  removed <- unique(unlist(lapply(na_coefs, function(cn) {
    m <- col_names[startsWith(cn, col_names)]
    if (length(m) > 0) m[which.max(nchar(m))] else character(0)
  })))
  if (length(removed) > 0)
    preds_df <- preds_df[, !col_names %in% removed, drop = FALSE]
  list(data = preds_df, removed = removed)
}

repeat {
  r <- .drop_aliased(preds_iter)
  if (length(r$removed) == 0) break
  cat("Removed aliased:", paste(r$removed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  preds_iter <- r$data
}
cat("Starting VIF loop with", ncol(preds_iter), "predictors\n")

iter_count <- 0
seen_states <- character(0)
repeat {
  iter_count <- iter_count + 1
  state <- paste(sort(names(preds_iter)), collapse = "|")
  if (state %in% seen_states) {
    stop("VIF filtering repeated the same predictor set. Check the predictor table before continuing.")
  }
  seen_states <- c(seen_states, state)

  rda_iter <- rda(Y_hell ~ ., data = preds_iter)
  vif_iter <- vif.cca(rda_iter)

  if (any(is.na(vif_iter))) {
    r <- .drop_aliased(preds_iter)
    if (length(r$removed) > 0) {
      fire_count_vars <- c("fire_1_num", "fire_2_num", "fire_3_num")
      if (any(r$removed %in% fire_count_vars))
        r$removed <- union(r$removed, intersect(fire_count_vars, names(preds_iter)))
      cat("Removing newly aliased:", paste(r$removed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
      preds_iter <- preds_iter[, !names(preds_iter) %in% r$removed, drop = FALSE]
    }
    if (length(r$removed) == 0) stop("Unresolved aliased predictors in VIF filtering.")
    next
  }

  cat("Iteration", iter_count, "| predictors:", ncol(preds_iter), "| max VIF:", round(max(vif_iter), 2), "\n")
  if (max(vif_iter) <= 5) break

  drop_dummy <- names(which.max(vif_iter))
  col_names <- names(preds_iter)
  dummy_matches <- col_names[startsWith(drop_dummy, col_names)]
  drop_var <- if (length(dummy_matches) > 0) dummy_matches[which.max(nchar(dummy_matches))] else drop_dummy
  fire_count_vars <- c("fire_1_num", "fire_2_num", "fire_3_num")
  if (drop_var %in% fire_count_vars) {
    drop_var <- intersect(fire_count_vars, col_names)
    cat("  Dropping fire count group:", paste(drop_var, collapse = ", "), "(VIF =", round(vif_iter[drop_dummy], 2), ")\n")
  } else {
    cat("  Dropping:", drop_var, "(VIF =", round(vif_iter[drop_dummy], 2), ")\n")
  }
  preds_iter <- preds_iter[, !col_names %in% drop_var, drop = FALSE]
}
cat("Final predictors (iterative):", paste(colnames(preds_iter), collapse = ", "), "\n")
colnames(preds_iter)
df_all3 <- preds_iter

colnames(df_all3)
write.csv(data.frame(variable = colnames(df_all3)),
          file = file.path(tables_dir, "selected_vars_allvars_afterVIF.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Each permutation test is calculated once and saved. Explicit seeds make this cleaned run repeatable; compare permutation results with your manuscript before release.

### Expected richness within three RDA1 site groups

Use the final manuscript RDA site scores with the same scaling and orientation
as Figure 4. Sites are divided at -0.1 and +0.1, including both boundaries in
the middle group. Sum the four species' occupancy predictions **within each
site first**, then calculate the mean, sample variance, and SD of those sums
across sites in each group. Do this separately for squirrels and
omnivore-carnivores. These are descriptive summaries of expected richness;
SD represents variation among sites, not uncertainty in model predictions.

```{r rda1-richness-summaries}
rda1_threshold <- 0.1
rda1_predictions <- df
rda1_scores <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(rda_mod2, display = "sites"))

# Preserve the same site-score scaling and axis orientation as the manuscript RDA.
# Confirm the saved row correspondence before matching predictions by deployment ID.
stopifnot(
  nrow(rda1_predictions) == 97L, nrow(rda1_scores) == 97L,
  !anyNA(rda1_predictions$deployment_id),
  !anyDuplicated(rda1_predictions$deployment_id),
  identical(rda1_predictions$deployment_id, fireClass$deployment_id),
  identical(rownames(rda1_scores), rownames(df_selected))
)
rda1_site_scores <- data.frame(
  deployment_id = fireClass$deployment_id, RDA1 = rda1_scores$RDA1
)
rda1_match <- match(rda1_predictions$deployment_id, rda1_site_scores$deployment_id)
stopifnot(!anyNA(rda1_match), all(is.finite(rda1_site_scores$RDA1)))
rda1_predictions$RDA1 <- rda1_site_scores$RDA1[rda1_match]

rda1_group_levels <- c("RDA1 < -0.1", "-0.1 <= RDA1 <= 0.1", "RDA1 > 0.1")
# Both boundary values (-0.1 and +0.1) belong to the middle group.
rda1_predictions$RDA1_group <- factor(
  ifelse(rda1_predictions$RDA1 < -rda1_threshold, rda1_group_levels[1],
         ifelse(rda1_predictions$RDA1 > rda1_threshold, rda1_group_levels[3],
                rda1_group_levels[2])),
  levels = rda1_group_levels
)

rda1_species_sets <- list(
  squirrel = list(
    title = "Squirrels", axis_name = "squirrel", colour = "#2F6F73",
    columns = c("California_Ground_Squirrel", "Golden_Mantled_Ground_Squirrel",
                "Western_Gray_Squirrel", "Douglass_Squirrel"),
    species_names = paste("California ground squirrel, golden-mantled ground squirrel,",
                          "Western gray squirrel, and Douglas squirrel")
  ),
  omnivore_carnivore = list(
    title = "Omnivore-carnivores", axis_name = "omnivore-carnivore", colour = "#008837",
    columns = c("American_Black_Bear", "Coyote", "Grey_Fox", "Striped_Skunk"),
    species_names = "American black bear, coyote, gray fox, and striped skunk"
  )
)

summarize_rda1_richness <- function(predictions, species_set) {
  stopifnot(all(species_set$columns %in% names(predictions)))
  psi <- as.matrix(predictions[, species_set$columns, drop = FALSE])
  stopifnot(is.numeric(psi), !anyNA(psi), all(is.finite(psi)),
            all(psi >= 0 & psi <= 1))

  # Sum probabilities at each site FIRST; then summarize those sums across sites.
  # This is expected richness for the four selected species, not abundance.
  sites <- predictions[, c("deployment_id", "RDA1", "RDA1_group", species_set$columns)]
  sites$expected_richness <- rowSums(psi)
  summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(sites$RDA1_group), function(group) {
    values <- sites$expected_richness[sites$RDA1_group == group]
    stopifnot(length(values) >= 2L)
    data.frame(
      species_group = species_set$title, RDA1_group = group, n_sites = length(values),
      mean_expected_richness = mean(values),
      sample_variance_expected_richness = stats::var(values),
      standard_deviation = stats::sd(values), minimum = min(values), maximum = max(values)
    )
  }))
  summary_table$RDA1_group <- factor(summary_table$RDA1_group,
                                    levels = levels(sites$RDA1_group))
  stopifnot(sum(summary_table$n_sites) == nrow(sites))

  list(sites = sites, summary = summary_table)
}
rda1_richness_results <- lapply(rda1_species_sets, function(species_set) {
  summarize_rda1_richness(rda1_predictions, species_set)
})
rda1_richness_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rda1_richness_results, `[[`, "summary"))
rownames(rda1_richness_summary) <- NULL
for (key in names(rda1_richness_results)) {
  prefix <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(key, "_occupancy_by_RDA1_threshold_0p1"))
  write.csv(rda1_richness_results[[key]]$sites, paste0(prefix, "_sites.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(rda1_richness_results[[key]]$summary, paste0(prefix, "_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
write.csv(rda1_richness_summary,
          file.path(tables_dir, "mammal_expected_richness_by_RDA1_threshold_0p1_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(rda1_richness_summary, row.names = FALSE, digits = 7)
```

## 7. Occupancy-uncertainty simulations

Retain your method: 10 independent normal draws for each site/species on the
logit scale, using its predicted mean and SE, followed by `plogis()`. These are
not joint parameter draws or occupancy-model refits. The simulated RDA uses
the main all-predictor RDA's `df_selected`, held fixed across simulations.

```{r simulate-occupancy}
set.seed(123)
pred_list <- predict(m6, type = "state", backTransform = FALSE)

n_sims <- 10
n_sp   <- length(pred_list)
n_site <- nrow(pred_list[[1]])

psi_sims <- vector("list", n_sims)

for (i in 1:n_sims) {

  mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_sp, ncol = n_site)

  for (s in 1:n_sp) {
    eta <- pred_list[[s]]$Predicted
    se  <- pred_list[[s]]$SE

    eta_sim <- rnorm(n_site, mean = eta, sd = se)
    psi_sim <- plogis(eta_sim)

    mat[s, ] <- psi_sim
  }

  psi_sims[[i]] <- mat
}
```

The three NMDS envfit analyses from your simulation block are retained and saved for plotting.

```{r simulated-nmds}
sp_names_sim <- names(pred_list)
nmds_sims <- vector("list", n_sims)
for (i in seq_len(n_sims)) {
  cat("-- Simulation", i, "--\n")

  sim_mat <- t(psi_sims[[i]])
  colnames(sim_mat) <- sp_names_sim
  rownames(sim_mat) <- det_his_forordering$deployment_id

  set.seed(123 + i)
  nmds_i <- metaMDS(sim_mat, distance = "bray", k = 2, try = 50, trymax = 200)
  cat("   Stress:", round(nmds_i$stress, 4), "\n")

  site_scores_i    <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_i, "sites"))
  species_scores_i <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_i, "species"))
  species_scores_i$species <- rownames(species_scores_i)
  species_scores_i$species <- gsub("_", " ", species_scores_i$species)

  site_scores_i <- cbind(fireClass, site_scores_i)

  hull_i <- site_scores_i %>%
    dplyr::group_by(severity_class_ha_rev) %>%
    dplyr::slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2))

  sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim_mat)
  func_i <- data.frame(
    omni_carn   = rowSums(sim_df[, c("American_Black_Bear", "Coyote", "Grey_Fox", "Striped_Skunk")], na.rm = TRUE),
    ground_gran = rowSums(sim_df[, c("Mule_Deer", "California_Ground_Squirrel", "Golden_Mantled_Ground_Squirrel")], na.rm = TRUE),
    canopy_gran = rowSums(sim_df[, c("Western_Gray_Squirrel", "Douglas's_Squirrel")], na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  func_i <- data.frame(scale(func_i, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))

  en_i     <- envfit(nmds_i, env,    permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)
  en_fu_i     <- envfit(nmds_i, func_i, permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)
  en_ev_i     <- envfit(nmds_i, envdf, permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)
  nmds_sims[[i]] <- list(
    nmds        = nmds_i,
    site_scores = site_scores_i,
    sp_scores   = species_scores_i,
    hull        = hull_i,
    envfit_cov  = en_i,
    envfit_func = en_fu_i,
    envfit_env  = en_ev_i,
    stress      = nmds_i$stress
  )
}
stresses <- vapply(nmds_sims, `[[`, numeric(1), "stress")
cat("\nStress across 10 simulations:\n")
print(round(stresses, 4))
cat("Mean:", round(mean(stresses), 4), "  Range:", paste(round(range(stresses), 4), collapse = " - "), "\n")
write.csv(data.frame(simulation = seq_len(n_sims), stress = stresses),
          file.path(tables_dir, "simulations/NMDS_stress.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r simulated-rda}
rda_values <- data.frame(
  simulation = integer(),
  r_squared = numeric(),
  adj_r_squared = numeric(),
  RDA1percent = numeric(),
  RDA2percent = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rda_sims <- vector("list", n_sims)
for (i in seq_len(n_sims)) {

  cat("-- Simulation", i, "--\n")

  sim_mat <- t(psi_sims[[i]])
  colnames(sim_mat) <- sp_names_sim
  rownames(sim_mat) <- det_his_forordering$deployment_id
  Y_sim <- decostand(sim_mat, "hellinger")

  preds_i <- df_selected

  rda_i <- rda(Y_sim ~ ., data = preds_i)
  rda_i
  r2_i <- RsquareAdj(rda_i)
  cat("   Adj. R²:", round(r2_i$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n")

  site_sc_i <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_i, display = "sites"))
  sp_sc_i   <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_i, display = "species"))
  env_sc_i  <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_i, display = "bp"))
  site_sc_i  <- cbind(fireClass, site_sc_i)
  hull_rda_i <- site_sc_i %>%
    dplyr::group_by(severity_class_ha_rev) %>%
    dplyr::slice(chull(RDA1, RDA2))

  eig_c_i <- rda_i$CCA$eig
  tot_i_i <- rda_i$tot.chi
  pct1_i  <- round(100 * eig_c_i[1] / tot_i_i, 1)
  pct2_i  <- round(100 * eig_c_i[2] / tot_i_i, 1)
  ax1_i   <- paste0("RDA1 (", pct1_i, "% of total inertia)")
  ax2_i   <- paste0("RDA2 (", pct2_i, "% of total inertia)")

  sim_title <- paste0("Sim ", i, "  (Adj. R² = ", round(r2_i$adj.r.squared, 3), ")")

  sim_row <- data.frame(
    simulation = i,
    r_squared = r2_i$r.squared,
    adj_r_squared = r2_i$adj.r.squared,
    RDA1percent = pct1_i,
    RDA2percent = pct2_i
  )

  rda_values <- rbind(rda_values, sim_row)
  rda_sims[[i]] <- list(
    rda         = rda_i,
    predictors  = colnames(preds_i),
    site_scores = site_sc_i,
    sp_scores   = sp_sc_i,
    env_scores  = env_sc_i,
    r2          = r2_i
  )
}

r2_vals <- vapply(rda_sims, function(x) x$r2$adj.r.squared, numeric(1))
cat("\nAdj. R² across 10 simulations:\n")
print(round(r2_vals, 4))
cat("Mean:", round(mean(r2_vals), 4), "  Range:", paste(round(range(r2_vals), 4), collapse = " - "), "\n")
```

Your summary columns are retained. `Mean_Pvalue` is a descriptive mean across simulations, not a combined hypothesis test.

```{r simulation-rda-summary}
anova_long <- lapply(seq_len(n_sims), function(i) {
  set.seed(123 + i)
  a <- as.data.frame(anova(rda_sims[[i]]$rda, by = "margin", permutations = 999))
  a$Variable <- rownames(a)
  a$Simulation <- i
  a[a$Variable != "Residual", ]
})
anova_long <- do.call(rbind, anova_long)

names(anova_long)[names(anova_long) == "Pr(>F)"] <- "Pvalue"

vars <- unique(anova_long$Variable)
wide <- do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(n_sims), function(i) {
  sub <- anova_long[anova_long$Simulation == i, c("Variable", "Variance", "Pvalue")]
  rownames(sub) <- sub$Variable
  sub <- sub[vars, c("Variance", "Pvalue")]
  colnames(sub) <- paste0(c("Variance_Sim", "Pvalue_Sim"), i)
  sub
}))
wide$Variable        <- vars
wide$Mean_Variance   <- rowMeans(wide[, grep("Variance_Sim", colnames(wide))])
wide$Mean_Pvalue     <- rowMeans(wide[, grep("Pvalue_Sim",   colnames(wide))])
wide <- wide[, c("Variable", grep("Sim", colnames(wide), value = TRUE),
                 "Mean_Variance", "Mean_Pvalue")]

print(round(wide[, -1], 4))
write.csv(wide, file.path(tables_dir, "simulations/anova_margin_sims2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

rda_values$mean_ajr <- mean(rda_values$adj_r_squared, na.rm = TRUE)
rda_values$SD_ajr <- sd(rda_values$adj_r_squared, na.rm = TRUE)
rda_values$CV_ajr <- rda_values$SD_ajr / rda_values$mean_ajr
write.csv(rda_values, file.path(tables_dir, "simulations/rda_values_sims2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Keep vegan's own fraction labels. This avoids guessing which shared fraction corresponds to each row, an ambiguity noted in the original code.

```{r simulated-variance-partitioning}
env_vp <- df %>% dplyr::select(aet_mean_1ha)
fire_vp <- fire_df %>% dplyr::select(max_sev_since_2015)
veg_vp <- df %>% dplyr::select(lg_snag_ha, dens_lg, Densiometer_CV, cwd_m3_,
                            gr.mean.percent.herbGrass, gr.mean.percent.shrub, vert_div)
vp_sims <- vector("list", n_sims)
vp_df <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_len(n_sims)) {
  sim_mat_i <- t(psi_sims[[i]])
  colnames(sim_mat_i) <- sp_names_sim
  Y_sim_i <- decostand(sim_mat_i, "hellinger")
  vp_i <- varpart(Y_sim_i, env_vp, fire_vp, veg_vp)
  vp_sims[[i]] <- vp_i
  fractions <- as.data.frame(vp_i$part$indfract)
  fractions$fraction <- rownames(fractions)
  fractions$simulation <- i
  vp_df <- rbind(vp_df, fractions)
}
write.csv(vp_df, file.path(tables_dir, "simulations/varpart_sim_fractions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
